entries.title: Simulator fails to boot
entries.root_cause: CoreSimulator cannot boot the selected simulator because its device data directory is missing. Recreate the simulator device.

entries.title: Requested simulator destination is unavailable
entries.root_cause: The workflow requests an iOS simulator runtime version that is not installed on the runner. Install that runtime or select an installed destination.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Both failures prevent tests from starting on a simulator, but this destination cannot be matched because its runtime is absent rather than failing to boot an existing device.

entries.title: Depth label rounding assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The depth label test expects 12.8 metres to display as 13 m, but the result is 12 m. Correct the rounding behavior or the expectation.

entries.title: Requested simulator runtime remains unavailable
entries.root_cause: The workflow requests an iOS simulator runtime version that is not installed on the runner. Install that runtime or select an installed destination.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run requests the same unavailable runtime for a different device model, on a newer runner image.
